items.claim: useOpenKeymap hint goes stale on overrides or action changes
captureGesture ignores a pen eraser press
createKeymapContribution's Escape guard misses a keyHeld Escape
a capture settled mid-press lets the release and click reach the page, including the macOS right-click case
captureGesture can't capture a middle or secondary drag
items.note: in the same change as the eraser fix (both are about the press's button)

items.claim: describeKeymap drops a key bound with Ctrl or Meta
items.note: The row now reads in words, like `Control-1`, because the shortcut chip has no field for Ctrl or Meta

items.claim: a key in the double-click window discards the pending click
items.note: This needed a behavior call nobody had made, so I made it: a key other than Escape settles on the pending click and is left to the page, and Escape still resolves `null`. It is recorded in `docs/unruled.md`.

items.claim: the end of one capture's release guard could remove a later capture's guard, because they all used the same `take` listener
items.note: (each guard now has its own listener)
